reviewPropositions: Style Profile should separate active styling authority, product repair work, and historical provenance instead of presenting them as one chronological kind of memory.
Every managed record should lead with what it changes, where it applies, and how to undo it; storage labels and raw provenance belong behind disclosure.
A hard owner constraint should be understandable through per-context eligibility, not only through prose that asks the model to remember it.
General styling/model failures belong in a product-quality work queue with inspectable evidence and an explicit resolution destination, never in personal style memory.
Provisional outfit reactions should remain visible on Style Profile only while they support a real owner action such as synthesis, inspection, or removal; processed provenance should be collapsed.
Managing, correcting, retiring, and resolving feedback must remain free; only the already-explicit synthesis action may authorize a paid model call.
The UI should project canonical meaning across chat, Visual Lab, Lookbook, garment records, and Tasks without presenting mirrored receipts as separate learned rules.
Backend stores and engine terminology should not determine the page hierarchy; the hierarchy should follow the owner's decisions: teach, constrain, repair, inspect, and undo.
